messages:
maria: FYI — just used Audit Peek in the console and saw rows from another customer in the detail panel. Not a partial match, full record from cust-B while I was scoped to cust-A. :eyes:

devon: whoa. can you repro? steps + URL?

maria: repro steps: open Dashboard -> Audit Peek (right rail) -> filter by customer=cust-A -> click event row id c123 -> detail shows customer_id=cust-B. Happened twice. Screenshot uploaded.

samir: any recent rollouts to the prefetch code? we added aggressive fanout last week.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T12:01Z service/audit-peek v3.14.2 -> prod (canary: 2 pods)

jess: cc @devon — possible cache key bug on the server or the client cache not including the viewed-customer?

devon: I grabbed logs around your click. Server returned correct payload for /internal/audit/detail?event=c123 (customer=cust-A). Frontend then issued a followup GET /internal/audit/related?event=c123 with header X-Customer-ID: cust-A but cache miss logic returned cachedResponse for key 'related:c123' (no customer scope).

maria: so frontend cache lives in a singleton and uses only event id as key.

samir: that explains cross-customer bleed. The fanout prefetch uses a shared LRU keyed by endpoint+args hash but we forgot to include customer id and role.

devon: quick patch idea: change keyBuilder to include ctx.customer_id and ctx.principal_role. Example patch: ```js
// before
return `${endpoint}:${argsHash}`
// after
return `${endpoint}:${ctx.customer_id || 'anon'}:${ctx.principal_role || 'user'}:${argsHash}`
```

jess: also need server-side guard. Add strict validation on related endpoint: if resp.customer_id !== ctx.customer_id then 403 and log.

samir: agreed. defenses in depth: 1) patch frontend cache key immediately, 2) server-side assertion and 403, 3) add e2e test that simulates two customers in same browser session.

maria: low-severity for now? exposing customer rows is high-severity. I'd tag P0 and rollback canary if more repros.

devon: rolling a tiny patch to canary now. If infra-bot sees >1 repro in canary, we'll rollback.

infra-bot: rollout started: service/audit-peek v3.14.3 -> canary (2 pods)

jess: I'll open a short RFC for telemetry: add a gated alert when server detects a customer mismatch (count>0 over 1m). Also trace id in logs for quick crawl.

samir: will add unit tests and a new integration assertion in the frontend harness. Also adding cache-key lint rule to ensure ctx fields present.

maria: thanks. leaving the thread but please ping me on the incident channel if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

devon: update: canary is clean for 10m, no more cross-customer deltas seen. Promoting to prod in 5.

infra-bot: rollout promoted: service/audit-peek v3.14.3 -> prod

jess: after prod promotion, we'll run an internal audit job to scan recent access logs for anomalous cross-customer reads (last 24h).

maria: good call. also let's add a tiny regression test to CI that asserts the related cache key includes customer id.

samir: PR #4271 opened with patch + tests. reviewers @devon @jess.

devon: LGTM, merging now.

maria: thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
